title: Bundled normalized proper/open comparison families
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring Λ, ProperOpenInterchangeData packages an ordinary proper/open comparison family δ, a bounded-below derived family γ, and properOpenInterchangeConditions Λ δ γ. properOpenInterchangeData is the pair selected by the existing coherence theorem, with that theorem’s proof of the conditions. The section-preserving inclusion determines δ uniquely, and the derived-unit normalization determines γ uniquely.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, first proof paragraph; categorical construction implementing its prescribed comparison.

proof.text: Use the exact same nested existential choices as the existing coherence theorem to fill the two data fields. Its choose_spec.choose_spec fills the conditions field. The structure fields retain the normalization proof. The constructor is irreducible, with a proved projection equation to the original second coherence witness. This lets consumers rewrite once without repeatedly unfolding the full dependent choice. Extracting the second conjunct gives the complete derived-unit normalization family. Extracting the first conjunct gives the section-preserving inclusion family. The accessors are proved theorems with explicit equation types. Their types retain only the needed equations, without the remaining coherence conjunction as implicit arguments.
